items.title: Dawn of War 4 gets a release date delay to "further refine the experience ahead of launch"

items.title: The "untranslatable" book that inspired Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 has been translated, and you can buy it later this year
items.description:
The first ever English translation of Alain Damasio’s Horde of the Counterwind (or, to give the book its original name La Horde du Contrevent) is going on sale later this year. The novel, a cult classic that is cited as one of the driving inspirations behind the acclaimed and best-selling Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, will be available in hardback on 13th October, 2026 via Abrams Books in the US. The UK date seems to be listed as 12th November on Amazon; we have contacted the publisher for clarification.

Read more

items.description:
UPDATE 12TH AUGUST 5.20PM: CD Projekt Red has confirmed the layoffs to Eurogamer.

items.description:

First off, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has confirmed that the publisher's sales are mostly digital, in response to Sony's controversial decision to stop manufacturing physical disc-based games. "Our business is well over 90% digitally distributed," he said during the call (thanks, Jason Schreier). "It's already a digital business."

On PS5 and Xbox, you will see an install-size reduction of roughly 15GB - down from 73GB - whilst the PC version reduces by a whopping 40GB. This means we're getting a reduction of roughly 20 percent on consoles, whereas on PC the file size will shrink by over 57 percent.

items.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls shows early signs of popularity, soaring up tournament entry leaderboards
items.description:
Marvel Tokon will be released unto the world by the terrible trio of Marvel, Sony, and Arc System Works later this week. While only the most talented of fortune tellers can say for sure how popular it will be, early indicators from fighting game tournament registration numbers paint a positive picture.

Read more

items.title: Memory chip maker Samsung says the component shortage will continue to get worse in 2027, while earning a pretty penny from it
items.description:
Samsung, one of the largest manufacturers of memory and storage in the world, has delivered bad news for anyone hoping the global component shortages will ease up soon. Samsung, which is responsible for about a third of the global memory supply, revealed in an earnings call that it expects the crisis to continue getting worse into next year.

Read more

items.title: Yet another price rise: AMD will reportedly raise its graphics card and memory prices alongside Nvidia
items.description:
Hot on the heels of Nvidia reportedly raising the price of its graphics cards and memory units comes word that rival component manufacturer AMD will do the same.

Read more

items.title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen director casually announces a Hard Mode is in the works
items.description:
The Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen reveal has easily been one of the most surprising of the year so far. Aside from everything new coming to the game with the upcoming expansion, Capcom has also been updating the core experience in several key ways.

Read more

items.title: Palworld Online is a new MMORPG coming to iOS and Android later this year
items.description:
With Palworld taking the world by storm (again), it turns out there's yet another major surprise tied to the creature-collecting survival game coming sooner than you'd expect. Palworld Online - an MMORPG - is coming to mobile later this year.

Read more

items.title: As hype builds for Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, Remake and Rebirth continue to sell well
items.description:
Final Fantasy 7 Remake and Rebirth have been selling "several times better" than expected in the wake of Revelation's Summer Game Fest 2026 reveal.

Read more

items.title: Control Resonant's story will take around 30 hours, Remedy says, with completionists looking at 50-hour runs
items.description:
Remedy has confirmed roughly how long Control Resonant will take to finish, along with fresh details on how its combat has evolved from the original game.

Read more

items.title: Story of Seasons mobile game cancelled as Marvelous cuts six-year Tencent partnership
items.description:
Marvelous has confirmed it's ending its partnership with Tencent, and cancelling a Story of Seasons mobile game that had been in the works since 2019.

Read more

items.title: Silent Hill: Townfall's dev team wrecked old TVs with magnets to make its in-game gadget feel real
items.description:
Silent Hill: Townfall studio Screen Burn used broken TVs and magnets to make its in-game gadget, the CRTV, feel analogue as well as look it.

Read more

items.title: Xbox UK and Europe console price hikes revealed - and it's even worse than we expected
items.description:
Xbox has finally revealed the price hikes recently rolled out across its hardware, and Xbox consoles in the UK are now between 34 and 49 percent more expensive than they were last month.

Read more

items.title: Star Wars, Metal Gear, and Halo composer Kazuma Jinnouchi confirmed as lead composer for Guild Wars 3
items.description:
ArenaNet has revealed the lead composer for its upcoming MMORPG Guild Wars 3. Kazuma Jinnouchi, known for his work on Star Wars, Metal Gear, and post-Bungie Halo games, is collaborating on the soundtrack.

Read more

items.title: EA Sports FC 26 may have almost 10 million daily active users, a far larger player count than public data may have you believe
items.description:
It seems like EA Sports FC 26 has a staggering number of daily active users, according to one content creator who claims to have heard first-hand about its popularity from a developer.

Read more

items.title: Surprise! After getting over 500,000 downloads on Steam, there's a Mortal Shell 2 beta live right now on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S
items.description:
Are you excited for Mortal Shell 2? The game, which is proving so popular ahead of release it recently sold out of its physical Revered Edition on PS5, has just announced a surprise beta - allowing players to dive in and check out its deconstructed soulslike mechanics for themselves.
